thread:
Maria: quick postmortem follow-up for /v1/stream-chat timeouts + partial-response spikes. saw a recurring long-tail pattern during peak sessions. proposing a short remediation plan and owner rotation.
Simon: thanks — can you paste the minimal repro logs?
Maria: pasted below. key pattern: connection open -> steady tokens -> sudden partial chunk and then client reconnect loop.
Maria: ```
2026-03-15T14:22:03Z stream conn 0x7f.. recv chunk-size=0
2026-03-15T14:22:03Z stream conn 0x7f.. heartbeat ok
2026-03-15T14:22:04Z stream conn 0x7f.. sent FIN? partial flush
2026-03-15T14:22:04Z http 502 upstream timeout after 120s
```
Kevin: looks like two things: upstream model container GC around that time and client backoff not exponential, so reconnect storms.
Julia: can we add a guard in the proxy to drop reconnects from same session for N seconds? also add metrics for "partial_chunk_rate" per model-version.
Simon: agree on metrics. I can own the proxy debounce change (PR by EOD Wed). assign to @simon. :thumbsup:
Maria: I'm volunteering to own the long-tail alert & dashboard. I'll create a dashboard showing partial_chunk_rate, reconnect_rate, and per-session duration percentile. Due Fri 03/19.
Kevin: I'll work with infra to increase model container GC margin and add a small pre-warm pool for heavy sessions. ETA next sprint.
InfraBot: Incident INC-4321 linked to thread. Creating a follow-up ticket: https://tracker/redwood/INC-4321
Maria: action items summary: Simon -> proxy debounce PR (due Wed 03/17), Maria -> dashboard + alert (due Fri 03/19), Kevin -> pre-warm GC change (sprint), Julia -> instrument partial_chunk metric + alerting lambda (due Mon 03/22). I'll add owners to the runbook.
Simon: also adding a small synthetic check that opens a long-lived stream for 5m and asserts no partial truncation. I'll add to CI.
Julia: for observability, suggest a weekly "streaming-health" digest to spot recurring patterns early. who wants to own rotation?
Kevin: ops team can take first two weeks; I'll coordinate.
Maria: ok owner rotation plan: ops (Kevin) weeks 1-2, SRE (Simon) weeks 3-4, ProdEng (Maria/Julia) on-call review thereafter. recurring calendar invite created. :calendar:
Simon: tagging a few follow-ups — can we prioritize alerts that correlate partial_chunk spikes with increased reconnects? that will reduce noisy pages.
Maria: agreed. I'll add correlation in the dashboard and link to the ticket.
Kevin: noted. will update INC-4321 with GC timeline and pre-warm plan.
Maria: thanks everyone. will post a short summary in #all-hands and link the ticket. ping me if you want to swap owners. :eyes:
Julia: copying the snippet into the runbook section 'streaming-long-tail': will include rollback steps and a playbook to force drain + pre-warm.
Maria: closing this thread for now; we will keep running updates in INC-4321 and a weekly digest.
InfraBot: Reminder scheduled: run streaming-health synthetic check daily at 08:00 UTC.
